intro.heading: Start Palimpsest on your computer
intro.body: Afterglow shows inventory and job status from the production Hub. The local CLI downloads and stores artifacts, while the local web dashboard manages your computer's images, layers and VMs. Neither environment proves execution in the other.
intro.credentials: The Afterglow login JWT, original Keystone token and native package key are different credentials. This guide does not read or copy tokens or keys. Keep passwords and tokens out of URLs, command arguments, screenshots and shared files.
install.heading: 1. Install the standalone CLI
install.body: In a terminal with uv installed, install the verified 0.3.5 client with Python 3.11 or newer. A Hub server installation or administrator privileges are not required.
install.path: If palimpsest is not found after installation, run uv tool update-shell and open a new terminal. The installation does not install the Lima, QEMU or libvirt tools needed to run local VMs.
platform.label: Local execution environment
platform.macosHelp: The default VM runtime is Lima 2.1 or newer with Apple VZ. Use an ARM64 cloud image. An x86_64 image or the OCI-root KVM path does not run unchanged on Apple Silicon.
platform.linuxHelp: VM execution requires QEMU, libvirt and access to /dev/kvm. Conventional cloud-image VMs support x86_64 and aarch64; OCI-root execution supports Linux amd64 KVM only.
platform.windowsHelp: These commands use a POSIX shell. The CLI can be installed in WSL2, but you must separately verify access to /dev/kvm and the required tools. This does not imply native Windows VM support.
connect.heading: 2. Connect to the production Hub with your original account
connect.body: Place your personal OpenStack clouds.yaml in the current directory and restrict its file permissions. The account needs the actual project scope and current Palimpsest authority. This command gets a token directly through the SDK and passes it only through the child process environment, without printing or saving it.
connect.project: The selected Afterglow project must match the actual scope in clouds.yaml. There is no automatic switch to another project or a service account.
connect.cloudHelp: This is a profile name under clouds, not a password.
connect.web: Open the local web dashboard connected to Hub
connect.digestHelp: Paste the sha256: prefix and 64 lowercase hex characters copied from Hub details. No invented example digest is used.
connect.invalidDigest: A complete sha256: digest is required. A short search prefix cannot identify a download.
connect.command: Original SDK authentication · run selected action
connect.inputRequired: Enter a cloud name and, when required, a complete digest to display an executable command.
connect.tokenLifetime: When the token expires, authenticate again with the original account. Legacy image/layer CLI commands do not send PALIMPSEST_PROJECT_ID as scope, so the command continues only if Hub /me's default project and user match the actual SDK actor. Otherwise use the project-scoped local web action. --output is a directory, not a filename; files use the full hex digest. Keep the local web terminal running until Ctrl-C. Uploads require separate current publish authority.
connect.webControl: Hub-connected web · allow downloads and local control
connect.webHelp: Ordinary web is read-only and cannot download. For explicitly project-scoped Hub downloads, select ‘allow downloads and local control’. It launches --allow-control inside the same SDK-authenticated process and also permits local builds and VM mutations; use only trusted local state.
native.apiBase: Full HTTPS API base supplied by the operator
native.apiBaseHelp: Do not infer an API path from a reference authority. Enter the operator-verified full address. Direct Hub uses /v1 while an Afterglow gateway uses /api/v1/palimpsest/hub; its authority must match the verified package authority.
native.apiRequired: Confirm and enter the full HTTPS API base on the same package authority to display a profile command.
local.heading: 3. Inspect the local store and web dashboard
local.body: You can inspect local artifacts and VMs without Hub. For Hub search and downloads, select ‘Open the local web dashboard connected to Hub’ above.
local.foreground: The web dashboard is a foreground process listening only on 127.0.0.1. Use the local URL printed by the CLI and stop it with Ctrl-C. Installation and ordinary inventory commands do not start a server.
local.control: This separate command enables local controls only; it does not inherit the SDK token or project above. For Hub downloads, use the authenticated ‘allow downloads and local control’ action above. Lifecycle authority applies only to resources managed by the selected local state.
local.layerBoundary: A SquashFS layer is not a bootable cloud image. VM execution requires an architecture-compatible verified base and a complete parent chain. A successful download is not proof of a successful VM run.
native.heading: 4. Connect native packages with a project key
native.body: OCI images and runtime bundles use a different protocol from legacy cloud images and SquashFS. First check the current project's namespace and a key with the exact scope and actions in the Native packages tab.
native.policy: The native package restriction on administrative and service identities remains. These identities can use legacy Hub reads and the local guide, but administrator privileges cannot substitute for a native key or project ownership.
native.command: Verified public gateway profile · interactive login
native.helper: Configure a Docker credential helper for the exact API base/projects/namespace key or credsStore. Use the public UUID for --username and enter the complete ppk_v1_ key only at the hidden terminal prompt. If profile creation fails, && stops login. Inspect an existing dmslab with registry inspect dmslab and explicitly correct its endpoint and namespace before reuse. No plaintext auths, host-only storage or automatic key issuance.
native.keyId: Public key UUID · never enter a secret
native.keyIdHelp: The public UUID of a key issued in the Native packages tab, not the complete key. Without it, only profile configuration is shown.
native.notReady: A verified namespace and public package authority are not available yet. Do not guess either; check authority and registration in the Native packages tab first.
